fields.System.Title: RPL-1 — Replenishment rules
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Define, per product per pick location, when a refill is needed and how much to bring.

Scope

In. Min/max rules, validation, bulk loading, coverage reporting.

Out. Slotting — deciding which products belong in pick faces at all.

Design notes

RPL-102 is not a trivial validation. Min 10 and max 12 means every couple of picks
triggers a refill of two units — constant trips, no benefit. Require the gap to be at least one
case quantity, or a configurable multiple of the minimum.

Max is capped by pick face capacity. A rule asking for more than the location physically
holds produces tasks that can never complete.

RPL-104 is the coverage check. A pick face with no rule never replenishes and runs dry
silently. This is the same class of problem as a location with no capacity — an optional field
that the logic actually requires.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Min and max set too close causing thrashing | [doc 09 §7.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Max exceeding pick face capacity | [doc 05 WF 11](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Pick faces with no rule at all | [doc 09 §7.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
